apps.label: Apps
apps.subtitle: Docker, PM2, systemd, config files, and terminal in one native app. Direct SSH only, zero server agent.

docker.label: Docker
docker.subtitle: Containers, images, volumes and networks in one native app. See what a cleanup reclaims before you run it.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.subtitle: A terminal with tabs, split view and a quick command bar, right inside the app. It warns you when you type or paste a dangerous command.

hero.videoAlt: Capstio on a Mac: the Docker Compose, PM2 and systemd apps of a server in one list

problem.title: Managing servers shouldn't feel like walking on eggshells.
problem.subtitle: Terminal commands are easy to mistype. Web dashboards are bloated to maintain. Capstio fixes both.

terminal.title: Terminal Anxiety
terminal.body: Looking up commands takes time, and one mistyped {docker rm} or {systemctl} can take down production.

config.title: Blind Config Edits
config.body: Config files are scattered and edited in nano. No backup, no syntax check: one wrong line and the service is down.

dashboard.title: Heavy Web Dashboards
dashboard.body: Web dashboards like Portainer need extra components installed on every server, then maintained and secured.

comparison.overline: The sweet spot between terminal & web panels
comparison.subtitle: Capstio connects over standard SSH and turns everyday actions into buttons.
